label: Text 1
transcript: The class read a contemporary short story called The Hour Before. Six pages. One narrator who is kept very tightly on the hour before something bigger happens off-stage. The class spent the lesson noticing what the author did not show. By the end, Maja had counted seven sentences in which a thing was named only by the way someone reacted to it.

label: Text 2
transcript: The hour before is the only one I remember. The kettle was on, whose whistle had not yet started; the cat was asleep, of whom I was, in the worst way, jealous; the corridor in which my mother stood was lit by the standing lamp, which she had bought in the year I learned to read. None of this is important. All of it is the only material I have.
